title: Chunky stylised trees generator (round and pine, 5 palettes)
summary: Code-generated cartoon trees: lumpy round crowns (~5.5 m) and stacked-cone pines (~6.5 m) with a warm-top/cool-underside ramp shader, sway and optional frost. Palettes: summer, spring, autumn, blossom (pink), winter (snow caps). Trunk collider included. No textures.
use_when: Cozy, cartoon, kids, farming, casual platformer or low-poly prompts where realistic trees would clash.
how_to_use: Instance res://starter/nature-chunky-trees/round_tree.tscn, round_tree_b.tscn, pine_tree.tscn, round_tree_autumn.tscn, round_tree_blossom.tscn or pine_tree_snow.tscn. Or add a Node3D with script res://starter/nature-chunky-trees/chunky_tree.gd and set kind ("round"/"pine"), variant (int seed), palette ("summer","spring","autumn","blossom","winter","custom" with top_color/bottom_color), trunk_color, collision (bool, StaticBody3D cylinder r 0.3 m, 2.4 m). Meshes are cached per variant; @tool so it shows in the editor.

contents.what: @tool generator Node3D (kind, variant, palette, colours, collision)
canopy ramp, vertex lumps, sway, frost, gust uniforms
6 presets: round_tree, round_tree_b, pine_tree, round_tree_autumn, round_tree_blossom, pine_tree_snow

provenance: original code from Grow Your Garden (garden/view/cozy/cozy_look.gd _mesh/_blob and cozy_foliage.gdshader), extracted into a standalone generator with palettes and collision

verified.notes: demo.tscn rendered in Compatibility and Forward+ with the preview stage; no script/shader errors; fresh-project copy imports and renders. Meshes are generated at runtime (@tool also builds them in the editor; editor view not separately tested). v1.1 (2026-10-03, owner rule: building blocks only): demo scene and demo scripts moved out; the remaining pieces are unchanged.
